description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $60–$120/hour equivalent, paid per accepted task
 Location: Global – Fully Remote
 Employment Type: Independent Contractor
 Time Commitment: 15+ hours per week
 Schedule: Flexible
 About the Role
 We are seeking skilled Lean 4 Developers with strong software development and formal verification expertise to create challenging technical tasks, develop machine-checked reference solutions, evaluate generated code, and establish objective standards for technical correctness.
 In this role, you will work with Lean 4 to design programming and formal verification challenges, write precise specifications, build reproducible Lean projects, and assess AI-generated code for correctness and reliability.
 This opportunity is well suited to Lean developers, formal verification engineers, proof-assistant developers, programming-language researchers, and software engineers experienced with machine-checked systems. Prior professional AI-training experience is not required. 
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Create technical tasks involving Lean 4 programming, formal verification, and machine-checked reasoning.
 Develop precise specifications, formal definitions, theorem statements, and complete reference solutions.
 Build self-contained, reproducible Lean projects with clearly defined dependencies and requirements.
 Evaluate generated Lean code for correctness, completeness, and compliance with technical specifications.
 Identify and troubleshoot type errors, dependency issues, failed tactics, and incorrect abstractions.
 Establish objective evaluation criteria for assessing the quality and reliability of Lean implementations.
 Review technical solutions and provide structured feedback to improve code quality and formal correctness.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Contributions to Mathlib, Lean, or other established Lean ecosystem projects.
 Experience developing or maintaining substantial Lean codebases.
 Hands-on experience with Lean metaprogramming, tactic development, or formal verification.
 Strong understanding of programming languages, type systems, theorem proving, and machine-checked verification.
 Public Proof of Skill
 Strong applicants should provide publicly accessible evidence of their Lean 4 development expertise, such as:
 Public Lean 4 repositories and development projects.
 Contributions to Mathlib or the broader Lean ecosystem.
 Formal verification projects and machine-checked implementations.
 Lean tactics, libraries, developer tools, or metaprogramming projects.
 Research papers or technical reports involving proof assistants.
 Open-source programming-language or formal verification contributions.
 Applicants should provide their GitHub username and links to their strongest Lean 4 projects, repositories, pull requests, or technical contributions.
 Application Process
 Submit an application outlining your Lean 4 development experience.
 Share links to relevant repositories, pull requests, publications, or technical projects.
 Complete an AI interview covering Lean development, debugging, and programming expertise.
 Candidates with relevant experience will proceed to hiring-manager review.
 Selected candidates will complete onboarding and begin their first assigned task.
 Compensation and Engagement
 Independent contractor engagement.
 Compensation is output-based, equivalent to $60–$120 per hour , with payment for tasks that meet project specifications and quality requirements.
 Minimum expected commitment of 15+ hours per week.
 Fully remote opportunity open to candidates globally.
 Flexible working schedule.
 Task availability and completion time may vary depending on project requirements.
